t: Adds new Idle Recommendation types in the Cost Optimization Hub API
This release enables AWS Cost Optimization Hub to show cost optimization recommendations for NAT Gateway.
Support recommendations for Aurora instance and Aurora cluster storage.
This release allows customers to modify their preferred commitment term and payment options.

This release adds resource type "MemoryDbReservedInstances" and resource type "DynamoDbReservedCapacity" to the GetRecommendation, ListRecommendations, and ListRecommendationSummaries APIs to support new MemoryDB and DynamoDB RI recommendations.
This release enables AWS Cost Optimization Hub to show cost optimization recommendations for Amazon Auto Scaling Groups, including those with single and mixed instance types.
This release adds action type "Delete" to the GetRecommendation, ListRecommendations and ListRecommendationSummaries APIs to support new EBS and ECS recommendations with action type "Delete".
This release adds savings percentage support to the ListRecommendationSummaries API.
This release enables AWS Cost Optimization Hub to show cost optimization recommendations for Amazon RDS MySQL and RDS PostgreSQL.
Adding includeMemberAccounts field to the response of ListEnrollmentStatuses API.

This release launches Cost Optimization Hub, a new AWS Billing and Cost Management feature that helps you consolidate and prioritize cost optimization recommendations across your AWS Organizations member accounts and AWS Regions, so that you can get the most out of your AWS spend.
